name: Extract RepoCli.Core shared library
description:
Move RepoLocator, Git, GitIdentity, Interaction, ExitCodes, GlobalSettings, JSON output conventions and the generic part of PluginGenerator into a RepoCli.Core project referenced by both tools.
Packed into each tool's package; no separate NuGet package. Exit codes, --json, --root and non-interactive rules stay identical across tools.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
